Have you ever wondered how the days of the week got their names? In the case of Thursday, for example, in dozens of languages around the world it is named after a god that is connected with thunder and lightning. In old Germanic dialects, the day was named in honor of a god of thunder that many people know today because of the Avengers movies: Thor. It is easy to see how the English word “Thursday” emerged from this old Germanic name, especially when you think of it as “Thor’s Day.” Why are the Avengers movies mentioned in the passage?

options.A: The movies center around a natural phenomenon.
options.B: They explain the origin of the English word “Thursday.”
options.C: Old Germanic dialects are heavily used in those movies.
options.D: One of the main characters is associated with the name of a weekday.
